title: Noisy Duel With Multiple Bullets
body_html:
Noisy Duel With Multiple Bullets

In the noisy duel with $m$ bullets for player 1 and $n$ bullets for player 2, assuming $p_1(t)=p_2(t)=t$, the game has value $$ \frac{m-n}{m+n}. $$ It is optimal for the player with $\max\{m,n\}$ bullets to shoot the first bullet at time $$ t_0=\frac1{m+n}. $$
